prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” interior painter for everyone in St. Louis — the right company depends on your scope, budget, timeline and priorities (speed, craftsmanship, eco-friendly paint, color help, etc.). I can either recommend specific local companies if you tell me your zip code/neighborhood, or I can give a short checklist so you can quickly identify the best contractor for your job. Here’s a compact guide to finding the right one:

Questions for you (to give tailored recommendations)
- Residential or commercial? Single room, whole house, or apartment?
- Rough square footage/number of rooms and ceilings/trim to be painted?
- Any special needs (wallpaper removal, repair work, high ceilings, lead paint, quick deadline)?
- Preferred budget or paint brand (e.g., Sherwin‑Williams, Benjamin Moore, low‑VOC)?

How to find the best painter in St. Louis
1. Search sources: Google Reviews, Yelp, Angi, BBB, Nextdoor, and local Facebook groups. Look for companies with many recent 4–5 star reviews for similar interior work.
2. Ask for 3 written estimates: compare scope, prep work, primer, paint brand/finish, number of coats, and timeline.
3. Verify credentials: general liability insurance, worker’s comp, local business registration. (Some cities require contractors to register; check St. Louis city/county rules.)
4. Check references: ask for 2–3 recent local jobs you can see, or phone references.
5. Confirm warranty and cleanup: written guarantee on workmanship, touch‑up policy, disposal of materials.
6. Payment terms: standard is small deposit (10–30%), payment on completion; avoid large up‑front cash demands.

Key things a good interior quote should include
- Detailed prep (sanding, patching nail holes, caulking, priming)
- Products and quantities (brand & sheen)
- Number of coats expected
- Start date and estimated completion
- Protection measures (floor/trim/furniture)
- Cleanup and disposal

Red flags
- Extremely low bids compared to others
- No written contract or scope
- Requests for full cash up front
- No insurance or unwillingness to provide proof
- Poor or no references

If you want, tell me your zip code or neighborhood and I’ll list 3–5 highly rated interior painting companies in the St. Louis area plus a sample email you can send to request estimates.
